units.source_text: 狂人的女儿点燃纸烟，看着玩耍的他们。

en.t: The madman's daughter lit a cigarette and watched them playing.

units.source_text: 他心情沉郁的画着火车和飞机。

en.t: In a gloomy mood, he was drawing trains and airplanes.

units.source_text: 幸好这个少年不是他的儿子。

en.t: Fortunately, this boy was not his son.

units.source_text: 可是，听到少年叫他“叔叔”，他竟然十分痛苦。

en.t: Yet when he heard the boy call him "uncle," he was unexpectedly deeply pained.
